Evan Morris: hey team :wave: Evan here (platform). Quick question — setting up my laptop and need Vault read + a KMS-encrypt test key for onboarding. What's the fastest path without accidentally getting permanent creds?

Lina Park: welcome Evan! :tada: fastest path we use: 1) submit https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets (select team=platform) 2) include your manager's greenlight in the ticket 3) DevEx can auto-add you to `secrets-readers` for read-only paths 4) request KMS-wrapped test key if you need local encryption (we don't hand out raw key material)

Evan Morris: cool — what TTLs should I request for dev work? don't want long-lived tokens.

Lina Park: for new hires we usually grant dev-sandbox creds (TTL 6h) so you can smoke-test things. CLI leases are short (1h or 4h depending on the operation). Production/service keys rotate every 90 days by default; if you need a different cadence include the desired TTL and approver in the ticket.

Alex Security: heads-up: when asking for KMS roles, include the exact operation (encrypt/decrypt/sign) and the justification. We require manager approval + eng-security review for any write/unseal/KMS-crypto roles. Also please avoid checking secrets into repos — use the secrets-action in CI, e.g., `uses: redwood/secrets-action@v1`.

Lina Park: handy example to fetch a password locally:
```
vault kv get -field=password secret/team/platform/dev-db
```
If you need to wrap data locally, request a KMS-encrypt role and we'll provide a wrapped key or an envelope encryption helper.

DevEx Bot: Hi Evan — placeholder workflow created. Steps: submit form, attach manager approval to ticket, expect eng-security review ~1 business day. After approval you'll get a DM with Okta group invite and CLI setup notes. Useful docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/onboarding and https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/rotation

Evan Morris: submitted form and opened SEC-5012, attached manager approval. Requested sandbox creds first (6h). Will update here when approved. Thanks! :thumbsup:
